invariant: A separator starts a body block. Preferred dimensions and paint use the same composed block: body with margins, title minimum dimensions, then outer margin. Body paints before titled separator.
causal_divergence: Rust measures a titled separator as an empty-body wrapper, then sums independent following lines; fixed title origin and per-line paint omit right body margin and block centering.
planned_change: Represent segmented note body blocks with measured body/title and margins; share preferred width/height and positioned painting. Source composition is max(B+H/2+4,H)+H/2 vertically and max(bodyWidth+6,titleWidth+8) horizontally. Preserve complete ordinary child allocation and message underline removal; do not change shared text.
perturbation_axes: title wider/narrower than body and font-size variation
